note: Reviewed attack surface of the Nuvio Plus release APK (P6-01, P6-03, P6-05). Checked against every built APK by .github/plus/security-surface.py; any new or removed line fails until reviewed here. Taken from the published Build 14 x86_64 APK.

surface.reason: App data (accounts, add-ons, settings) is not copied by Android backup.

Upstream Nuvio: add-ons and self-hosted streaming servers are often plain http on the local network. Accepted risk, recorded as B15-SEC-02; not changed in Build 15 (would break working add-ons, owner rule 10).

surface.line: exported activity com.nuvio.app.LinkActivity permission=None filters=[android.intent.action.VIEW https nuvio.tv; android.intent.action.VIEW nuvio; android.intent.action.VIEW nuvio auth; android.intent.action.VIEW stremio]
surface.reason: Deep links nuvio://, stremio:// and https://nuvio.tv (sign-in callback, add-on and content links). Its links take the same path as LinkActivity (handleAppUrl); installing an add-on from a link asks the user first (P6-02).
